from subject import extract_topics, topic_error, VALIDATOR_ID, PY_TOPIC_PATTERN, TS_TOPIC_PATTERN, FLAT_TOPIC_PATTERN, ENV_PREFIX_PATTERN


def test_extract_topics_py_basic():
    source = 'TOPIC_foo = "onex.core.producer.event.v1"\n'
    result = extract_topics("file.py", source)
    assert result == [(1, "onex.core.producer.event.v1")]


def test_extract_topics_ts_basic():
    source = 'export const TOPIC_bar = "onex.core.producer.event.v1"\n'
    result = extract_topics("file.ts", source)
    assert result == [(1, "onex.core.producer.event.v1")]


def test_extract_topics_unknown_extension():
    source = 'TOPIC_foo = "onex.core.producer.event.v1"\n'
    result = extract_topics("file.txt", source)
    assert result == []


def test_extract_topics_no_match():
    source = 'some_other_variable = "value"\n'
    result = extract_topics("file.py", source)
    assert result == []


def test_extract_topics_multiple_matches():
    source = 'TOPIC_a = "onex.a.b.c.v1"\nSUFFIX_b = "onex.d.e.f.v2"\n'
    result = extract_topics("file.py", source)
    assert result == [(1, "onex.a.b.c.v1"), (2, "onex.d.e.f.v2")]


def test_extract_topics_line_numbers():
    source = 'line1\nline2\nTOPIC_x = "onex.x.y.z.v1"\n'
    result = extract_topics("file.py", source)
    assert result == [(3, "onex.x.y.z.v1")]


def test_topic_error_env_prefix():
    result = topic_error("{env}.some.topic")
    assert result == ("env-prefix", "topic uses {env}. prefix (legacy pattern): {env}.some.topic")


def test_topic_error_flat_topic():
    result = topic_error("flat-topic-name")
    assert result == ("flat-topic", "flat legacy topic name (must use onex.<kind>.<producer>.<event>.v<n>): flat-topic-name")


def test_topic_error_valid_topic():
    result = topic_error("onex.core.producer.event.v1")
    assert result is None


def test_topic_error_invalid_suffix():
    result = topic_error("onex.core.producer.event")
    assert result is not None
    assert result[0] == "canonical-suffix"


def test_constants_exist():
    assert VALIDATOR_ID == "arch-topic-names"
    assert PY_TOPIC_PATTERN.pattern is not None
    assert TS_TOPIC_PATTERN.pattern is not None
    assert FLAT_TOPIC_PATTERN.pattern is not None
    assert ENV_PREFIX_PATTERN.pattern is not None
